def factor_drawdown_regime_adaptive(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    high_regime = df_copy['style_gate_resvol_high'] > 0
    rolling_max_fast = df_copy['close'].rolling(5, min_periods=5).max()
    drawdown_fast = (df_copy['close'] / rolling_max_fast) - 1.0
    high = df_copy['high'].values.astype(np.float64)
    low = df_copy['low'].values.astype(np.float64)
    close = df_copy['close'].values.astype(np.float64)
    atr_fast = pd.Series(talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=5), index=df_copy.index).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    normalized_dd_fast = drawdown_fast / atr_fast
    stress_fast = normalized_dd_fast.rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()
    rolling_max_slow = df_copy['close'].rolling(20, min_periods=20).max()
    drawdown_slow = (df_copy['close'] / rolling_max_slow) - 1.0
    atr_slow = pd.Series(talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=20), index=df_copy.index).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    normalized_dd_slow = drawdown_slow / atr_slow
    stress_slow = normalized_dd_slow.rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()
    factor = np.where(high_regime, stress_fast, stress_slow)
    df_copy['factor_drawdown_regime_adaptive'] = factor
    return df_copy['factor_drawdown_regime_adaptive']
